message:
docs: reconcile current World Agent contracts and accepted authority direction

Replace read-only/proposed-only descriptions with the source-backed finite authoring, context and question implementation. Preserve hosted release, general composition, art and grant-admission gaps. Align player usage and separate Worker accounting with the current owner decision. No runtime permission, provider call or new live qualification.

replacements.old: **Status: accepted target application contract.** The existing finite native workshop and separate [world-authorized read-only bootstrap](architecture.md#repertoire-relationship-and-mcp-foundation) are delivered subsets; this document defines the shared service that both the UI and [MCP transport](world-agent-mcp.md) must use.
replacements.new: **Status: accepted target application contract with finite shared read and reviewed-write services implemented.** The [current runtime](world-agent-runtime.md#durable-write-sessions) supports seven native authoring kinds, exact draft/review/Apply, scoped continuity and structured human questions. Local HTTP and [MCP](world-agent-mcp.md#implemented-write-surface) use the same operation descriptors and native owners. General composition, complete impact analysis, art and hosted release qualification remain separate work; the target catalogue below is not the current invocable API.

replacements.old: Existing `catalogue`, `materials`, `recipes`, `inspect_recipe`, `inspect_modules` and `validate` operations remain the narrow implemented adapter. Their actor-bound behavior is a current limitation, not the target World Agent permission model. Keep their implementation evidence in Architecture; the following catalogue is the target service surface, enabled one real adapter at a time.
replacements.new: The earlier actor-scoped `catalogue`, `materials`, `recipes`, `inspect_recipe`, `inspect_modules` and `validate` loop remains a finite compatibility path. It is no longer the only implemented service. The world-authorized reader and session-bound authoring dispatcher now support the [current native profiles](world-agent-runtime.md#scoped-context-and-native-save-for-review), without turning administrative inspection into actor knowledge. Their strict descriptors in `apps/server/src/world-tools.ts` and `world-authoring-contracts.ts` generate discovery for both transports. The following table describes broader target operations; use actual discovery rather than sending its illustrative fields or assuming every listed tool exists.

replacements.old: Questions are for conflicting requirements, meaningful design tradeoffs, changed rights/cost/scope, and irreversible consequences. Ordinary field names, pagination and routine codec choices are implementation details. Progress reflects real job states, not invented percentage estimates. Show the shared $5 allowance and purpose breakdown without a compulsory separate image budget.
replacements.new: Questions are for conflicting requirements, meaningful design tradeoffs, changed rights/cost/scope, and irreversible consequences. Ordinary field names, pagination and routine codec choices are implementation details. Progress reflects real job states, not invented percentage estimates. Players see abstract remaining usage; owner controls expose the session allowance, purpose breakdown, settled costs and holds under the [current economics contract](world-agent-runtime.md#1-product-decisions). The default attributable session cap is $5, not a compulsory separate image budget or an all-inclusive shared-Worker charge.

replacements.old: The service can first register only implemented kinds while reporting the rest as unsupported. Do not ship empty generic interfaces and mark general mechanics authoring complete. The current owner-authoring exception remains unresolved; until decided, existing player-lock and god-only new-stat policies continue to apply.
replacements.new: Register only implemented kinds and report the rest as unsupported. Do not ship empty generic interfaces and mark general mechanics authoring complete. Creator/scoped full-invention authority is an [accepted target](../archive/03-design-proposals/invention-governance-and-ownership.md#special-player-invention-permission), with grant persistence/admission still open under MP02/INV-1.7. Until that implementation is qualified, the current player-lock and god-only new-stat gates remain enforced. The finite owner tools do not implement the broader exception.

replacements.old: This profile is an interim subset of the unified service contract, not another world registry or permission engine. The [architecture](architecture.md#repertoire-relationship-and-mcp-foundation) owns exact current coverage and caps. Full draft/approval/action/art/funding adapters, real Macrofold execution and general traversal/impact work remain in INV-15/16/18/20. `ol_inspect` accepts actual exact-source refs; reference-only nodes may require a future authorized archive reader. A cursor/source failure must not be described as a nonexistent mechanic.
replacements.new: This independently usable read profile is not another world registry or permission engine. [Architecture](architecture.md#repertoire-relationship-and-mcp-foundation) owns its source coverage and caps. The same reader now includes schema discovery, entity search and bounded `ol_trace` witnesses; [reviewed writes](world-agent-runtime.md#durable-write-sessions), selected native submissions and the local Macrofold journeys are delivered through the existing authoring owner. [WW07](maintainers/world-agent-writes.md#remaining-implementation-and-qualification) retains deployment-specific interoperability/accounting qualification; INV-15/17/18/20 retain full impact closure, richer composition, art and funding extensions. `ol_inspect` accepts actual exact-source refs; reference-only nodes may need a future authorized archive reader. A cursor/source failure must not be described as a nonexistent mechanic.

replacements.old: Actual live Macrofold interoperability/usefulness, general composition and generated-art funding remain separate acceptance gates.
replacements.new: The approved finite local Macrofold journeys, context foundation and structured-question bridge have recorded native/browser/live evidence; deployment-specific interoperability, general composition and generated-art funding remain separate acceptance gates.

replacements.old: The owner requested the [World Agent context project](projects/world-agent-context/README.md) to simplify inputs, tools and templates with medium effort. It is a proposed design tracked by WW17–WW23, not current runtime behavior; existing authority and continuity requirements below remain controlling.
replacements.new: The owner approved the [World Agent context project](projects/world-agent-context/README.md). Its finite medium-effort context/tool foundation is implemented and qualified under WW18–WW23, as detailed [below](#scoped-context-and-native-save-for-review). General dependency proof and later optimization remain separate work; the existing authority and continuity requirements below remain controlling.

replacements.old: [Current write evidence](verification/workshop-continuation.md) and [remaining gates](maintainers/world-agent-writes.md) distinguish actual local execution from live-harness qualification.
replacements.new: [Current write evidence](verification/workshop-continuation.md), [context qualification](verification/world-agent-context.md#final-local-qualification), [question acceptance](verification/invention-questions.md#final-acceptance--september-29) and [remaining gates](maintainers/world-agent-writes.md) distinguish the qualified finite local native/browser/live journeys from deployment-specific release and broader capability qualification.

replacements.old: Modern-profile and real Macrofold end-to-end compatibility are not established by local protocol observations.
replacements.new: Modern-profile and hosted deployment compatibility are not established by those initial protocol observations. Later [context](verification/world-agent-context.md#final-local-qualification) and [question](verification/invention-questions.md#final-acceptance--september-29) evidence qualifies the named local native Macrofold journeys; WW07 retains the exact deployable API/runtime/connector gate.

replacements.old: `OPEN_LEGEND_MCP_WRITES=true` adds the nine current shared authoring tools to the existing read catalogue.
replacements.new: `OPEN_LEGEND_MCP_WRITES=true` adds the implemented `WORLD_AUTHORING_TOOLS` descriptors to the existing read catalogue. That catalogue includes administrative draft/review operations and kind-specific submission tools; a native agent receives only its selected profile from `profileTools`, not every registered write tool.

replacements.old: uses the existing backend/provisioner with session-scoped model/worker accounting and sends a bounded goal/continuity brief.
replacements.new: uses the existing backend/provisioner with session-scoped attributable Run accounting and sends a bounded goal/continuity brief. Shared Worker capacity is separately owner-managed; a conversation cannot buy, reallocate or shut it down.

replacements.old: [INV-21 focused delivery](maintainers/world-agent-writes.md) retains live Macrofold forwarding/usefulness, multi-user grants, broader body changes, strict image-inclusive external budgeting and sustained scale qualification.
replacements.new: [INV-21 focused delivery](maintainers/world-agent-writes.md) records later finite local live forwarding/usefulness and retains deployment-specific release, multi-user grants, broader body changes, strict image-inclusive external budgeting and sustained scale qualification.

replacements.old: The current proposed owner exception for authoring while player invention is locked is not implicitly adopted here: follow existing governance until that separate permission is explicitly selected and implemented.
replacements.new: The [creator/scoped full-invention exception](../archive/03-design-proposals/invention-governance-and-ownership.md#special-player-invention-permission) is an accepted target, not an unresolved product choice. MP02/INV-1.7 still own its grant storage and admission implementation; this document does not enable it or bypass the currently enforced player-lock gate.

replacements.old: This does not decide the broader unresolved owner-authoring exception or permit an NPC to call owner tools.
replacements.new: This does not implement the [accepted creator/scoped full-invention grant](../archive/03-design-proposals/invention-governance-and-ownership.md#special-player-invention-permission), still owned by MP02/INV-1.7, or permit an NPC to call owner tools.

replacements.old: Removal, arbitrary current-value edits, replacement of native needs, changing the body's sense/controller bundle, bulk species migration and shared-law replacement require their own reviewed native adapters.
replacements.new: Exact edits to already attached custom values are delivered by the separate [attribute-values adapter](world-agent-inspection-and-edits.md#reviewed-custom-attribute-values). Removal, arbitrary state edits, replacement of native needs, changing the body's sense/controller bundle, bulk species migration and shared-law replacement still require their own reviewed native adapters.
